description: Normalized hook events shared by every conformance run. `event` is the
contract-level name; `payload` carries vendor-neutral fields that each
vendor encoder maps into its own stdin shape. An adapter driven via
--adapter-cmd receives this JSON verbatim on stdin and must answer with
the normalized response JSON described in docs/guides/writing-a-bridge.md.

events.description: A new agent session begins; adapter should write a heartbeat and inject full context (doctrine + workspace + hot pack + write-back tail).
The user submitted a prompt; adapter should inject a lightweight workspace diff, deduped against the previous identical injection.
A Bash tool call is pending; L3 rules are advisory — the decision stays allow.
A tool call finished; counts toward session activity and may carry a decision signal.
A tool call that carries a decision signal (edit/commit activity); nudges must be rate-limited.
A tool call whose payload contains a sentinel secret; the durable store must never contain the raw value. The sentinel is AWS's documented example key (public, not a real credential).
Context compaction is about to run; adapter may rebuild the hot pack as a side effect but must not try to inject (vendor schemas forbid it).
The session ended; adapter must digest the session exactly once (idempotent), remove its heartbeat and per-session state, and release claims.
Unknown future event; the adapter must exit 0 with a permissive response (forward compatibility).
